description: Check progress of a Strategy Lab optimization run started with start_optimization_run. Each experiment (AI mutation + backtest) typically takes 1-2+ minutes, so poll every 15-30 seconds rather than tightly looping. While the run is going, savedVersionId (once it appears) is the strategy version holding the best result found so far -- it is not the strategy's latestVersion yet. When status is completed, progress.verdict gives the out-of-sample result: on a pass (single-pair runs: also when inconclusive) savedVersionId is now the strategy's latestVersion -- inspect it with list_strategy_versions. A held run (failed check, or cancelled) has no savedVersionId; instead progress.heldVersionId is the held version and progress.heldBecause says why, latestVersion is unchanged, and the author can accept it in the TradeStaq web app ("Use this version anyway"). progress.cancelled is true for a cancelled run, and progress.stopReason says why a run stopped early (cancelled, time_budget, balance or data_unavailable_on_resume). If the run was started with autoPromote:true, check progress.autoPromoted (true if it was actually promoted to stable) and progress.autoPromoteSkippedReason (present and explains why if it wasn't); otherwise promote it yourself with promote_strategy_version if you like it. A completed or failed run stays queryable for 24 hours. MULTI-PAIR runs: progress.basket lists the pairs; progress.baselinePerAsset and progress.bestPerAsset give each pair's result, with the best version marked W/T/L (won, tied, lost) or cured against the original on that pair; progress.validation.perAsset and progress.validation.breadth give the out-of-sample check per pair and how many pairs passed; experiments[].perAsset is kept only on the best and the latest experiment (this tool asks for the summary view). While a run waits to start, queue gives its position and etaMinutes (estimated minutes until it starts). After an auto-promote, progress.autoPromote.untestedPairs lists pairs that bots following the stable version trade but this run did not test (reported only; it never blocks the promote). verdict, heldVersionId and heldBecause work as for single-pair runs.
name: get_optimization_status
